summary: Phase 1 Multi-Warehouse testing: all 12 backend tests pass; frontend WarehouseSwitcher/badge and warehouse_id filtering work end-to-end. Login → /manager shows '🇺🇦 UA' badge. After creating 2nd active warehouse PL2 via POST /api/admin/warehouses, badge auto-transforms into dropdown with UA/PL2 options; switching to PL2 shows empty dashboard (correct filtering). /admin/warehouses page renders table with stats (products/orders/clients) and both default UA and inactive test rows. All /manager/* pages (dashboard, picking-list, returns-list, overdue-list) load without JS errors. The only console 404s seen on returns-list/overdue-list are pre-existing missing product image assets (/api/uploads/products/*.png) — unrelated to Phase 1 multi-warehouse work. Backend soft-delete archives warehouses correctly and removes them from _me/accessible. Test warehouse cleaned up at the end.

issues: Archived warehouses are still visible in the list by default (frontend passes include_inactive?); backend GET /api/admin/warehouses defaults to active only — recommend aligning frontend to request include_inactive=true explicitly or hide archived rows unless a toggle is on.
Many 404s on /api/uploads/products/*.png (pre-existing broken image files on disk, not a Phase 1 regression). Consider a default placeholder image to avoid noisy console errors.

action_items: Optional: provide default/placeholder image fallback for missing product uploads to clean console log noise on returns-list / overdue-list.
Optional: on /admin/warehouses, confirm whether archived warehouses should be visible by default; if not, change list_warehouses callsite to omit include_inactive or add toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: warehouses.py DELETE endpoint is a soft-delete (sets is_active=FALSE). This is correct and documented; UI should rely on _me/accessible or active-only list for switcher — currently it does, confirmed working.

WarehouseSwitcher correctly swaps between badge (<=1 wh) and dropdown (>=2 wh). data-testid attributes present on all key elements (warehouse-badge, warehouse-switcher, warehouse-switcher-btn, warehouse-switcher-menu, warehouse-option-{CODE}, manage-warehouses-link).
Create endpoint accepts is_default=true and correctly flips other rows to false. No bug observed.
Backend _me/accessible returns clean JSON (no Mongo _id — SQL schema). Good.
All manager/* endpoints accept warehouse_id query param; filtering verified empty for new wh and populated for UA (wh_id=1).
seed_data_creation: Transient test warehouses created and deleted during each test run (PLT{HHMMSS} by pytest module fixture; PL2 for manual switcher test — both soft-deleted at end).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 Multi-Warehouse is fully functional end-to-end. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_warehouses_phase1.py are stable regression suite. If adding Phase 2 (transfers / per-warehouse stock), extend this file. Note: soft-delete leaves archived warehouses in DB; filter via is_active=TRUE for active-only lists. The 404s on product images are pre-existing and NOT related to this phase.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs discovered in Phase 1.
